title: Translation memory (one file per language: l10n/tm/<lang>.json)
description: Keyed by translation-unit hash as produced by tree_diff.hash_tree. See .claude/rules/l10n-pipeline-spec.md §3.

schema.description: Format discriminator; bump on breaking change.

language.description: BCP-47-style language code this file holds translations for (he, ru).

entries.description: Map of unit hash to entry. Serialize with sorted keys for deterministic diffs.

source.description: Canonical source text (the inline markdown source of the unit) this translation was made from. The entry's key is tree_diff's hash of this text.

translation.description: Translated text; every placeholder present in source survives verbatim (spec §5).

model.description: Model identifier that produced the translation, e.g. openai/gpt-oss-120b.

prompt_version.description: Version of the translation prompt (app/groq_api.py TRANSLATION_PROMPT) in force when translated, e.g. "v1". Older than current ⇒ eligible for a refresh run.

review_status.description: machine = fresh from the model; recheck = content moved, context may have changed (RECHECK action); approved = human-reviewed.

action.description: Provenance: produced fresh, or as a revision of a prior translation.
